note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are considering buying a small office building for $6,000,000. It is now 80% leased.

answers.common.decision: Whether to make an offer at the asking price; the investment committee decides.
answers.common.deadline: The seller wants offers within a month.
answers.common.materials: At full occupancy the building's rent would be $900,000 a year. Operating costs not recovered from tenants are $300,000 a year. Similar buildings in the area trade at a 7.5% yield.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Work out the yield on the asking price today and once fully let.
answers.finance-modeling.data: The seller's rent roll and operating cost statement, in US dollars.
